instance_id: template id + store run id + valid time + sha256 of the authority product. Yesterday's TAF is a different instance. Scheduling updates the concept, not the instance.
serve_rule: If the recomputed key differs from the frozen key by more than the tolerance, do not serve the card. Missing data is a skipped card. Never fill a missing value with zero.

difficulty.easy: One station or one cell. The value is a single field. One comparison.
difficulty.medium: A definition has to be applied (ceiling is BKN or OVC; TEMPO is a group; the card names which product is authoritative).
difficulty.hard: A field over the grid, or a contrast where the obvious neighbouring maximum is the wrong answer.

tolerances.time: exact TAF group or exact model hour

global_rules: Name one authority product. If the TAF and the model disagree, the card says which one is scored.
Ceiling is the lowest BKN or OVC base. FEW and SCT are not a ceiling. CAVOK is not a cloud group.
A teaching threshold is labelled as a teaching threshold. It is not the AIP alternate minima and it is not 14 CFR 91.169.
TEMPO and INTER count only when the stem says they count.

Geostrophic speed uses a central difference on MSLP, density 1.225 kg/m³, f = 2 Ω sin φ, and only where latitude is at least 30° from the equator. Report the model's 10 m wind at the same cell. Do not call the geostrophic number a surface wind.
A pressure centre on the outer two rows or columns of the grid is not a centre.
No front position unless a front product exists.
Australian cards use metres, feet, hPa, knots and UTC. They do not use statute miles or inches of mercury.
practiceLocale is au or us when the scored rule differs. A miss on an au card does not schedule the us twin as the same fact.
Verbatim METAR, TAF and SIGMET text is evidence class verify (aviationweather). It stays out of a foss export. A number taken from an ECMWF CC BY grid may be the evidence for a CC BY question.
The map notice stands: situational awareness only, not a flight briefing. The card says so in the footer, not as a sentence in the stem.

inputs: TAF raw for each ICAO in the set
templates.key: The ICAO whose first counted group has a BKN or OVC base at or below ceiling_ft, or a visibility below visibility_m. The key includes the group type and the UTC start.
traps: the FM group at the same time as a worse TEMPO
CAVOK treated as missing rather than as a pass

templates.key: The runway end with the greatest positive headwind_kt. A tie is the whole set of ends.
traps: choosing the runway facing the wind by name without the heading
using the gust when the METAR has no gust

inputs: one FM or base wind group, steady speed not the gust
true headings from the runway file
templates.formula: diff = wrap(wind_dir − heading) to ±180°. headwind = speed × cos(diff). crosswind = speed × sin(diff). Positive crosswind is from the right.
templates.key: End or ends with the greatest headwind, within 1 kt.
traps: using the gust instead of the steady wind

inputs: mslp, u10, v10 float16 for one valid time
templates.formula: ug = −(1/(ρ f)) ∂p/∂y, vg = (1/(ρ f)) ∂p/∂x, y northward, f = 2 Ω sin φ, ρ = 1.225. Speed in knots. Direction is the meteorological FROM direction.
templates.key: Latitude, longitude, speed, direction, MSLP, and the 10 m wind at that cell.
traps: the tropical 1/f spike outside the latitude floor
calling the geostrophic speed the surface wind

templates.key: The cell with the greatest 10 m speed in knots.
traps: answering with the geostrophic maximum instead

templates.key: The maximum hPa and the set of cells that share it. A maximum on the outer two cells is rejected.
traps: a low on the southern edge of the window reported as the feature of the day

inputs: mucape on the same valid time
a comparison region that is outside the polygon
templates.key: Maximum MUCAPE inside the polygon, its cell, and the maximum in the comparison region. The scored location of the storm is the SIGMET, not the CAPE maximum.
traps: pointing at the Cape York or Kimberley CAPE maximum because the number is bigger

templates.formula: elevation_ft from the point file. PA = elevation_ft + (1013.25 − QNH) × 30. ISA = 15 − 2 × PA/1000. DA = PA + 120 × (OAT − ISA).
templates.key: Which station has the higher density altitude, and both values in feet.
traps: using the model 2 m temperature instead of the METAR
using an AIP elevation that is not in the store
treating the 30 ft and 120 ft rules as exact

templates.check: Interpolate 0 °C between the upper-air levels. If that height differs by more than 200 m, do not serve.
templates.key: The station with the lower freezing level, in metres.
traps: reading the higher number as the lower level

inputs: hourly visibility on the named point series
templates.key: The point and the first hour where visibility is below the threshold.
traps: answering from the TAF when the stem says the model series
